summary: CareView Communications filed a routine Form 8-K on October 5, 2026, reporting a Sixteenth Amendment to its Credit Agreement with PDL Investment Holdings, LLC. The amendment extends the maturity date of its existing secured debt facility. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private transaction — is present. The filing is an ordinary credit-facility modification under Items 1.01 and 2.03, accompanied by Item 9.01 financial statements and exhibits. There are no deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or advisor involvement. This is a standard debt-management disclosure with no risk-arb angle.
